commands.name: search-models
commands.summary: Search and filter Hub models by keyword, task, library, app, parameter count, inference provider or license, with sorting and pages

commands.name: quick-search
commands.summary: Autocomplete-style quick search that returns matching models, datasets, Spaces, orgs and users together

commands.name: full-text-search
commands.summary: Full-text search inside model, dataset or Space cards (README content), with highlighted matches

commands.name: list-model-tags
commands.summary: List all model license tag ids (e.g. license:apache-2.0) usable in search-models --license

commands.name: get-model
commands.summary: Get full public metadata for a model: tags, downloads, likes, config, card data, file list (siblings), parameter counts, gating

commands.name: get-model-scan
commands.summary: Get the security (malware/pickle) scan status of a model repository's files

commands.name: list-model-files
commands.summary: List files on a model repository's main branch with sizes, last commit message, date and download links

commands.name: get-model-file
commands.summary: Download the raw text of a file from a model repository's main branch, e.g. README.md or config.json

commands.name: search-datasets
commands.summary: Search and filter Hub datasets by keyword, modality and format, with sorting and pages

commands.name: get-dataset
commands.summary: Get a dataset's Croissant metadata (name, description, license, splits, fields, file distribution) from its page

commands.name: get-dataset-scan
commands.summary: Get the security scan status of a dataset repository's files

commands.name: check-dataset-viewer
commands.summary: Check which dataset-viewer features (viewer, preview, search, filter, statistics) are available for a dataset split

commands.name: get-dataset-statistics
commands.summary: Get per-column statistics (types, null counts, unique values, label frequencies, length histograms) for a dataset split

commands.name: search-spaces
commands.summary: Search Hugging Face Spaces (AI demo apps) by keyword, with sorting

commands.name: get-organization
commands.summary: List the repositories shown in an organization's or user's profile collections (models and datasets with stats)

dropped.name: semantic-search-spaces
dropped.reason: Returned an empty array for a common query. The required wire params are unknown and can't be confirmed, and search-spaces already covers Space search.
